# From Zero to API

*Build your first web service with Python. No web experience needed.*

A short book for people who have learned basic Python and want to build and
deploy something real. Sold as a PDF.

- Chapters are Markdown in `chapters/`.
- The PDF is built with `./build.sh` (pandoc + WeasyPrint) using
  `theme/pdf.css`.
- Reader feedback from the early-access edition is in `feedback/`.
